bull_case: A 5x path exists if core cyber-resilience ARR compounds, identity/cloud workloads broaden, Agent Cloud becomes a second platform, and SBC-adjusted owner FCF/share reaches the Bull path without relying only on multiple expansion.
bear_case: Bear value is only about 30% of price. Growth mean-reversion, heavy SBC/dilution, weaker Agent Cloud monetization or margin delay could destroy most of the valuation even without bankruptcy.
thesis: RBRK has genuine power-law upside but also severe valuation downside. Locked Bull/current is about 5.28x, while Bear/current is about 0.30x. Core cyber resilience, identity/cloud expansion and Agent Cloud create more than one economic path, but the Bull case still requires exceptional owner-FCF conversion. Broad growth-persistence base rates justify keeping Bull probability modest rather than extrapolating 30%+ ARR growth.

evidence.claim: Locked DCF gives Bull value $563.05 versus frozen price $106.71, or about 5.28x; the path is driven by owner FCF/share reaching $45 by year 10 with a 25x terminal multiple.
Locked Bear value is $31.58, about 0.296x current price, so a failed cash-conversion thesis can cause large permanent capital impairment even if the company remains solvent.
Subscription ARR reached $1.66B, up 33% y/y; >$100K ARR customers reached 3,084, up 23%; average subscription dollar-based NRR was above 119%.

Rubrik had GA Agent Cloud by FY2026 year-end and by Q2 FY2027 had launched integrations and governance/recovery products spanning Claude Code, cloud apps and agent identity, creating an adjacent AI-operations value pool beyond core backup/recovery.
evidence.source: Rubrik FY2026 and Q2 FY2027 official results plus 2026 Agent Cloud announcements

evidence.claim: McKinsey's study of 5,000 large public companies found only one in eight sustained >10% annual revenue growth over a decade and only one in three top-quartile growers sustained their growth rate in the next five years.

Bessembinder found that among US stocks already achieving a 5x cumulative gross return from 1973-2020, 29.8% later achieved another 5x to reach 25x; extreme winners exist but are rare and the statistic is not company-specific.

counterevidence: Base and Bull values are 81% and 85% terminal-value dependent, so upside is unusually sensitive to long-run margin, dilution and multiple assumptions.
SBC-adjusted TTM owner-FCF stress proxy is still negative even though company-defined FCF is positive.
Agent Cloud is strategically interesting but separate revenue, retention and margins are not disclosed.
The external base rates are broad and not specific to post-IPO cyber-resilience SaaS.
unknowns: Agent Cloud standalone ARR, gross margin and customer retention.
Normalized SBC/share dilution once post-IPO grants mature.
Cyber-resilience category growth and Rubrik market share over a full recession.
Whether identity recovery and Agent Cloud become economically independent growth engines.
A directly comparable public-company base rate for 5x outcomes in cyber-security software.
falsifiers: Reduce upside_path if ARR growth drops below 20% before SBC-adjusted owner FCF/share turns positive.
Treat the 5x path as broken if Agent Cloud remains immaterial and core customer expansion falls below 110% NRR.
Raise permanent-loss risk if net liquidity erodes materially while dilution remains above 5% annually.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Frozen price $106.71 is far below locked Bull value $563.05; the defined Bull+ price condition is not met.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Bear valuation implies severe price impairment, but current liquidity, positive operating cash flow and a 0% convertible due 2030 do not support an excessive bankruptcy probability. The price-risk penalty remains in permanent_loss=50.

key_kpis.name: Subscription ARR growth / NRR
key_kpis.threshold: ARR >25% and NRR >115%; review if ARR <20%

key_kpis.name: SBC-adjusted owner FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: sustainably positive and tracking Base path

key_kpis.name: Agent Cloud economic contribution
key_kpis.threshold: separately disclosed material ARR or customer expansion

next_checks: Build a cyber/SaaS-specific growth-persistence base-rate set.
Separate Agent Cloud, identity and core cyber-resilience revenue/value pools.
Update dilution-adjusted owner-FCF path after FY2027 year-end.

subscores.rationale: Bull/current exceeds 5x, but the economic path still depends on exceptional owner-FCF conversion. Core cyber resilience, identity/cloud expansion and Agent Cloud provide multiple value pools, supporting the 75 anchor rather than 90.
Bear/current is about 0.296x, squarely in the 0.2-0.4 observable band. Net cash is positive, but TTM OCF does not exceed total convertible principal, so no +10 modifier applies.

The scenario range is sensitivity-tested and external growth/power-law base rates are explicitly used to prevent straight-line extrapolation. Cyber-specific base rates are still missing, so 90 is not justified.

uncertainties.rationale: The three value pools are strategically distinct but not yet separately monetized or disclosed.
Bear value is model-sensitive and does not capture an exact probability of business failure.
Base rates are broad public-company and market-return studies, not a matched RBRK cohort.
